polity.canonical_name_en: Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea

activity.notes: On 9 October 1940 the Korean Provisional Assembly elected Kim Gu chairman under the revised Provisional Constitution. The chair represented the Provisional Government and held supreme command of its armed forces. After liberation, the Provisional Government was not recognized as Korea's sovereign government by the occupation authorities, although its organization and titles continued in Korean nationalist politics. On 3 March 1947 the National Assembly aligned with the provisional-government succession framework selected Syngman Rhee as chairman and Kim Gu as vice-chairman; ATLAS uses that formal leadership transition as the endpoint and does not imply sovereign governmental control over occupied Korea after 1945.
